description: Document templates: the latex preset plus one guard. A template's contents are copied verbatim into every student repository generated from it, and those repositories have no Renovate. Anything pinned here is therefore frozen there for good.

Keep the shared-workflow reference on the moving v1 tag. The latex preset pins github-actions references to a digest, which is right for a repository that has an updater; here it would freeze the one channel that reaches student repositories after they are created. Third-party actions stay SHA-pinned: those are real versions, and a student repository holding a fixed actions/checkout is harmless.
